# Ezaz Ansari

> Designer in Bengaluru, 13+ years in design and front-end. Principal Product Designer at Upstox. Previously led Visual Experience at Swiggy across Food, Dineout, Snacc, and Toing.

## About

I'm a designer who's spent more than a decade bridging the gap between "it works" and "it actually looks good."

Currently, I'm a Principal Product Designer at Upstox in Bengaluru, making investing fun. I know. I heard it too. Let me cook.

Before this, I spent four years leading Visual Experience at Swiggy, making sure everything flowed seamlessly from the things you see to the things you feel. Earlier, I led design at WeWork India and wrote code for The Glitch. When the logic brain takes a break, I'm usually drawing cats, credit-maxxing on Claude, or 3D-printing a small army of toy characters.

## Experience

- 2026 — present: Principal Product Designer at Upstox
- 2022 — 2026: Lead Visual Experience Designer (II) at Swiggy, working across Food, Dineout, Snacc, and Toing
- 2021 — 2022: Independent — creative consultant, freelance designer
- 2017 — 2021: Design Manager at WeWork India
- 2014 — 2017: Senior Front-end Developer at Penguin Thoughts
- 2013 — 2014: Senior Front-end Developer at The Glitch — Awwwards Honorable Mention for the studio site
- 2010 — 2013: BSc, Information Technology — University of Mumbai

## Skills and focus

- Visual experience and interaction design
- Motion design and animation runtimes (helped roll out Rive across Swiggy)
- Brand identity (Snacc, Toing — Gen Z–first identities)
- Front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
- Design systems

## About this site

Single-page personal site, hand-coded in HTML / CSS / JS. Type set in Departure Mono. Features a drawing canvas: toggle draw mode and scribble on the page, then save a snapshot.
